name: Sliding Window Maximum
statement:
1. You are given a number n, representing the size of array a.
2. You are given n numbers, representing the elements of array a.
3. You are given a number k, representing the size of window.
4. You are required to find and print the maximum element in every window of size k.

e.g.
for the array [2 9 3 8 1 7 12 6 14 4 32 0 7 19 8 12 6] and k = 4, the answer is [9 9 8 12 12 14 14 32 32 32 32 19 19 19]
outputFormat: Maximum of each window in separate line

Solution :

Our approach will be depending on next greater element on the right so that we can code it in O(n).

We will be running loops, let us say loop i and loop j. j checks for the next greater element of i inside the window and increments to it if it is present inside the window. Once j is incremented to the next greater element of I it starts searching for the next greater element of that element on which it is. If it finds the next greater element inside the window only then it jumps onto it and if the next greater element is outside the window then the element j is on is the answer for that window.

So basically j is jumping from next greater element to next greater element until the next greater element is outside the window and whose next greater element is outside is the answer for that window.

Taking an example-

Taking window [e f g h], i is on e and j is also on e. The next greater element of e is g so j jumps to g, the next greater element of g is h so j jumps to h. Now the next greater element of h is outside the window so our maximum for this window is h.
